I kept a notebook for eleven years before I understood what it was for.
---
A notebook is not for remembering. The entries I reread are the ones I already remember.
---
A notebook is for slowing down. A sentence written by hand takes as long as it takes.
---
Most early notebook entries are bad, and you will want to tear them out. Keep them: once a decade you open one and wince.
---
Nobody needs a particular pen. What matters is that the tool cannot be edited.
